title: Red Hat Security Advisory: gnome-remote-desktop security update
description: A denial-of-service vulnerability exists in GNOME Remote Desktop's VNC TLS I/O handlers due to busy-wait conditions triggered by GNUTLS_E_AGAIN and GNUTLS_E_INTERRUPTED errors. This issue affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support and related variants. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-109832 and is rated as having an important security impact by Red Hat. A security update addressing this issue is available.
